title: Fix Puzzle 2d NodeShape Build
description: Fix puzzle 2d wasm build failures from ambiguous NodeShape types and missing geometry imports in board_host.rs.
summary: Resolved puzzle 2d wasm build failures caused by duplicate NodeShape and Camera types. Unified NodeShape on mathematical_graph::NodeShape in directed port types, wired board_host to infinite_canvas::camera::Camera, and added missing geometry imports (rectangle_handle_angle_toward, normalize_or_zero). Verified with cargo build and wasm-pack build.
